job.title: Managing Director, Asia
job.description:
Managing Director, Asia | Data Centre Contractor | Singapore

Two years ago this business didn't exist. Today it's a data centre contractor with a nine-figure turnover, operating across several APAC markets and contracting directly with one of the world's largest hyperscalers.

It has grown on a simple idea. Clients always deal with someone senior enough to make a decision on the spot, not a layer of middle management. The founders now want a Managing Director to carry that approach into the next stage of growth.

What the role involves

  • Owning and growing the core hyperscale relationship.
  • Winning new clients and bringing new work to quote across the region.
  • Working closely with the founder on the commercial side and alongside three operational and technical directors.
  • Building a leadership structure that runs without the founders day to day, as the business sets its sights on a global footprint.

There's no revenue target in year one. The focus is on keeping current revenue, bringing new clients on board and building a credible pipeline. You'll have real autonomy, with direct access to the founder for decisions above your approval level.

What you'll bring

  • Experience running a business or holding a senior commercial leadership role.
  • A background in the data centre construction and delivery space, whether with a contractor, a specialist subcontractor, a consultancy or a supply-chain partner working on live builds.
  • A track record with hyperscale clients, and an understanding of how projects are won, priced and delivered on site.
  • Client relationships and the credibility to attract strong people.
  • A commercial leaning, a strong communication style with senior hyperscale stakeholders and enthusiasm for regional travel.

Package
A strong base salary, reflecting the seniority of the role.

The role is based in Singapore with regular travel across the region. All conversations are confidential, so message me directly if you'd like to talk.

job.title: Senior PM / Project Director
job.description:
West Melbourne | Data Centre Construction | 9-Building Development | 2.5–3 Year Programme

Salary: $350K - 500K plus package

This is a major project. It needs a Project Director who knows how to deliver at scale.

We are partnering with a leading data centre contractor to appoint an experienced Project Director to take the lead on a significant, nine-building data centre development in West Melbourne.

This is a major greenfield project, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a large-scale programme and play a defining role in its successful delivery from the early stages through to completion.

With design progressing and site mobilisation on the horizon, the successful individual will be instrumental in setting the project up for success, shaping the delivery strategy and building on the capability of an established project team.

THE ROLE

You will be the driving force behind the delivery of this development.
Taking overall responsibility for project execution, you will lead across operations, commercial performance, programme, client relationships and the wider project team.

This is not simply about overseeing construction. It is about creating the structure, setting the standards and driving the performance required to deliver a complex, multi-building development successfully.

Working alongside an established management team, you will bring strong leadership, commercial discipline and a clear approach to project delivery. You will also play an important role in developing the people around you, strengthening the team and ensuring the right systems and processes are in place to support the programme.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take full accountability for the successful execution of the nine-building development.
  • Establish robust project controls, systems and processes that drive consistency, performance and accountability.
  • Provide direction across programme, commercial, contractual and operational activities.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client, ensuring expectations are managed and commitments are delivered.

  • Create a culture focused on quality, safety, collaboration and getting the job done right.

This is an opportunity for an established Project Director, or an ambitious Senior Project Manager ready to step into a broader leadership position, to take on a significant data centre development and make a lasting impact on its delivery.

Grid Connections Manager, APAC (Data Centres)
Singapore | Regional travel across APAC

Power decides whether a data centre site goes ahead. This role sits right at that point.

We’re working with a global data centre platform that is growing its pipeline across APAC. They need a hands-on power and grid specialist, based in Singapore, to take sites from the first conversation with the utility through to energisation.

This is for someone who wants to do the work, not just oversee it. You’ll have consultants to support you, but you’ll be the person who knows the grid, talks to the utility and keeps the connection moving.

What you’ll do

  • Run power due diligence when new sites come up, engaging the utility and directing consultants to confirm capacity and timelines.
  • Own grid connection applications, technical studies and connection agreements with transmission and distribution operators.
  • Work on PPAs and other power contracts alongside the legal and commercial teams.
  • Be the main point of contact with grid operators on your projects.
  • Work with development, engineering, construction, legal and country teams so grid delivery is built into the wider programme.
  • Track grid risks and milestones from capacity reservation to energisation, and raise issues early with clear options.
  • Help build repeatable processes as the APAC programme scales.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience of grid connection or power infrastructure delivery, from application through to connection agreement, and ideally energisation.
  • Direct knowledge of at least one or two APAC grids and their utility processes, with skills that carry across markets.
  • Enough technical grounding in HV and MV connections and grid codes to hold your own with utilities and engineers, plus the commercial sense to handle connection contracts and PPAs.
  • Experience working across engineering, construction, legal and commercial teams.
  • A degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Willingness to travel across the region as projects need, at times up to 30%.

Backgrounds from data centre developers, renewables or battery storage developers, utilities and network operators are all relevant. Experience on 100MW+ connections, or a second Asian language, would be an advantage.

job.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance Program Manager
job.description:
A hyperscale data centre developer and operator with campuses across APAC is building out its ICT function, and this is one of the first senior hires in a new GRC vertical.

You'll own governance, risk and compliance across the data centre OT and ICT estate: building management, power and cooling controls, monitoring platforms and the corporate systems that sit around them. The immediate priority is ISO 27001 alignment and certification, alongside the Australian requirements that apply to critical data centre assets, such as the SOCI Act and Essential Eight.

This is a build, not a maintenance job. There is no GRC platform in place yet, so you'll recommend one, implement it and use it to map, monitor and report controls across the business.

Why it's worth a look

  • A genuine greenfield remit: you'll shape the function, the platform and the team
  • An APAC role at a business with significant capacity planned across the region
  • A hiring manager with a clear, mapped team plan and further hires to follow

What you'll do

  • Set the GRC strategy, roadmap and operating model for data centre OT and ICT
  • Lead ISO 27001 alignment and certification, plus the country-specific controls that go beyond it, starting with Australia
  • Select and implement a GRC platform, and build the control library, testing and reporting on it
  • Own the OT and ICT risk register, risk acceptance and remediation tracking
  • Lead internal and external audits and customer assurance requests
  • Set vendor and third-party security expectations, including remote access
  • Report clearly on risk posture and control maturity to the executive team
  • Lead an assistant manager and direct outsourced specialists

What they're looking for

  • Significant GRC, technology risk or assurance experience in data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities, telecoms, financial services or similar regulated environments
  • Hands-on ISO 27001 implementation, ideally taking an organisation through certification
  • A working knowledge of Australian requirements such as the SOCI Act and Essential Eight
  • Experience building controls on a GRC platform such as ServiceNow IRM, Archer or OneTrust
  • Exposure to OT, building management or industrial control environments is a strong advantage; deep SOC or security engineering experience is not the core of this role
  • The ability to explain technical risk to senior, non-technical stakeholders

job.title: Senior Manager, OT Solutions Architect
job.description:
A hyperscale data centre developer and operator with campuses across APAC is hiring a senior OT Solution Architect, based in Australia, where most of its build programme sits.

This is a hands-on OT role. You'll own the architecture for the systems that keep the data halls running: BMS, EPMS, SCADA, DCIM, PLCs and controls, and how they sit on the underlying IT network. You'll also make sure the platforms and vendors chosen meet the organisation's security and governance standards.

It's a senior individual contributor role. You won't run an internal team, but you will direct outsourced specialists, integrators and technology partners, so technical credibility and influence matter more than headcount.

What you'll do

  • Own the target architecture and standards for data centre OT: BMS, EPMS, SCADA, DCIM, PLCs, controllers and monitoring
  • Define how OT platforms connect to enterprise IT and the network, with resilience and supportability built in
  • Assess vendor platforms and appliances, and set requirements for vendor connectivity and remote support
  • Provide architecture assurance on new builds, expansions and upgrades through design, commissioning and handover
  • Plan lifecycle, obsolescence and resilience across OT platforms
  • Brief senior leaders on OT risk, investment priorities and trade-offs

What they're looking for

  • Hands-on senior experience with BMS, EPMS, SCADA and OT controls in data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities or industrial environments
  • Solid underlying IT and networking knowledge: routing, switching, firewalls and remote access
  • Experience directing vendors and integrators through design, commissioning and handover
  • OT cyber security knowledge, such as IEC 62443 or segmentation design, and GRC exposure are a plus
  • Certifications such as GICSP, CCNP or IEC 62443 are useful

Why it's worth a look

  • You'll set the OT architecture standard for a large build programme rather than inherit someone else's
  • It sits where data centre engineering, controls and IT meet
  • A newly structured ICT team with a clear plan and investment behind it
